_comment: Levels (V): account level (max 200), social level (personal, max 200 like the account, V 2026-10-02) and guild level (organisation, max 50). XP to reach level L = a*(L-1)^2 + b*(L-1). Account and social XP are computed from what the player did (rebalancing them is retroactive); guild XP is stored on the guild (it belongs to the organisation, not to the members, and stays when one leaves). V: level 200 takes months, then x10 (V: 'PLUS PLUS'): about 3M XP.
